name: Omana 2: Omaenchi Moeteruzo
original_name: おまな2 おまえんち萌えてるぞ
source:
This is a sequel of "Omae no Natsuyasumi". In this story, the keyword is "idol and the world of show business". Will Corona be able to become an idol?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081030014035/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003068]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
《我的暑假》的续作。本篇关键词是“偶像与演艺圈”。火野ころな能否成功成为偶像？

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081030014035/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003068]Eroge Shop[/url]]
